We're trying to discuss EIP-2935 and it seemed like you were most interested in it as per last ACD. Hi Tim, sorry I missed it (was not really aware there was a special call for the EIP) let me join, I see it is still running nobody there? Hi <@489256758989029405> The meeting just concluded I will add the summary and share here I thought that we agreed for a separate breakout room per each discussion? otherwise there will be difficulty to chase the different channels Generally the announcement is done on this channel but happy to add you to the calendar invite it is a lot of discussion here... now we have channels called: eips, breakout-room, eth1-x research is there a clear separation of their roles? Yes, past two meetings only included YOLO v2 discussion Yeah I was in favor of deleting this one and just using AllCoreDevs but people said it'd make ACD too chatty So this one is now "technical discussing AllCoreDevs", as I understand it technical discussing AllCoreDevs is called breakout room? 🙂 so what is eips for? > so what is eips for? I assume the eips "processs", but not 100% sure. <@!187490121698770945>, is that right? there is also an allcoredevs channel and eth1x mess it is a mess I am sure we can fix it 🙂 TL;DR re: EIP-2935 is that on last week's call, <@!425279588009246720> mentioned there had been several similar proposals in the past and that there were more details to flesh out on it. There is no major opposition to it, but <@!211091239112671234> and others would like to see someone try and move the conversations forward before we begin implementation. On the last ACD call, it seemed like Nethermind was interested in having this EIP, so we were wondering if you had researched it more or started an implementation? how about merging allcoredevs with this one and then just create a separate channel for particular eips so people can quickly filter the more detailed discussion? Yeah, and just have an EIPs top-level category 👍 eips top level is allcoredevs 🙂 or potentially eth1x if eth1 specific So we can have: - EIPs - EIP-2718 - EIP-2935 - ... - Process I think the top level one is not needed > eips top level is allcoredevs 🙂 <@!489256758989029405> Yes, I just meant in the Discord UI, i.e. this thing merging information from various channels is something that already complained about in th epast we had discord, gitter, ethresear.ch and EthMagicians now we will need to collect also various channels from Discord as for eip-2935 - yes, we think it is important but we haven't implemented it yet we will push for it earliest possible if nobody else does and then we can present the solution and others can pick it up Yeah I think it'd be good if Nethermind took the lead on it not much to discuss here on zoom calls I guess unless there are specific questions - but I think there are not that many and can be answered on the chat? Given it's written by Vitalik, it may need someone else to help move it forward 😅 Re: questions, I think Axic and Martin had the bulk of them on last week's call. I don't recall much more details than "this is a bit more complicated than it seems" and "there have been similar proposals in the past, so why this one?". I'll let them chime in 🙂 i'm weighing eip-2935 against the approach that flyclient proposes, and if i could convince myself that the flyclient approach has enough benefits for it to be worth the additional complexity, I'd be interested in championing it Summary from today's meeting - https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/207#issuecomment-692136980 Updated YOLOv2 list with client status here for quick reference - https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1BomvS0hjc88eTfx1b8Ufa6KYS3vMEb2c8TQ5HJWx2lc/edit#gid=408811124 As I suggested before, the deep-dive technical break-out discussions need to be as asynchronous as possible. Because otherwise, instead of attending 1 call every 2 weeks, everyone has to attend 5 calls, things will get more frustrating. Leading asynchronous discussion requires different kind of facilitation skills from what most people are used to. To be effective facilitator, one needs to understand the discussion and summarise it regularly to present "the current state of things" Another thing I see on Discord is an "instinct" to "fork" the communication whenever there are more than 1 topic is getting discussed. This is not sustainable and leads to too many channels to monitor > To be effective facilitator, one needs to understand the discussion and summarise it regularly to present "the current state of things" I think this would be a very valuable thing for champions of EIPs to do. Kind of a weekly (or more frequently if many updates) summary and set of open questions. Bleh, sorry I messed the meeting. I should have been to that one since I am the champion of 2718. Feel free to @mention me in the future if you think I should be present! > Bleh, sorry I messed the meeting. I should have been to that one since I am the champion of 2718. Feel free to @mention me in the future if you think I should be present! <@!301186049323958275> Sure! Going forward, I'll "@" all the author/champion listed in the agenda.
